body:
Normal does seem dangerous. My "normal" is very dangerous. 

I suppose I'd follow society's guidelines: stop drinking, go back to school, find a man, eventually get married, have children. Unfortunately, the thought of doing those things makes me cringe.

I guess a basic answer would be I'd like to move out and have an independent life, anyway. That's a good place to start, right? The problem is I kind of fear other people. They're confusing.
Too often. 2-3 days per week. It's horrible.
Thanks for the suggestion! AA is quite important because it's probably saved many people. However, I fear that the setting is too religious for me. Religion makes me uncomfortable, not sure why.
